name: OKRs
summary: Objectives and measurable key results, tracked per quarter.

lists.name: Objectives
lists.description: Ambitious, qualitative goals for the quarter, three to five at most. Each card is one objective.

lists.name: Key results
lists.description: Measurable outcomes that prove an objective was met: a number, a baseline and a target.

lists.name: In progress
lists.description: Key results being actively worked on. Update the number weekly and say how confident you are.

lists.name: Achieved
lists.description: Reached (or closed with a lesson). Score honestly: 0.7 is a good result.

cards.name: Make onboarding effortless
cards.description:
**Objective**
New customers succeed on their own.

tasks.name: Cut median time to first value from 2 days to 1 hour
